status: read-only design and source audit; no fitting or outcome analysis

scope.evaluation_cohort: 2024-01-05 through 2026-09-19, 1,779 races, 17,412 runner rows, 269 race dates; 2026 partial
scope.evaluation_target: unordered exact Top3 set; pair event means both horses are members of actual Top3
scope.candidate_policy: select argmax pair-in-Top3 probability, then top K conditional completion probabilities for K=3,4,6
warnings: The unordered Top3 set distribution does not identify exact Top2 or ordered finish probabilities.
The source cohort has been reused in historical development research and is not independent confirmation.
The joint relationship candidate failed its two pre-registered research gates.
The cohort uses complete normal finishes; do not extend automatically to ties, scratches, disqualifications, or non-finishes.

jeju/research/20261010_joint_relationshi.role: saved unordered exact-Top3 joint probabilities for matched_baseline and candidate arms
saved runner Top3 marginals and actual Top3 labels; no exact-rank probabilities

jeju/research/20261010_style_history_abl.role: frozen runner features and actual finish_position label keyed by api_record_id

definitions.pair_top3_probability: P(i,j both Top3) = sum over k distinct from i,j of q({i,j,k})
definitions.conditional_completion_probability: P(k is remaining Top3 horse | i,j both Top3) = q({i,j,k}) / P(i,j both Top3)
definitions.pair_miss: actual Top3 does not contain the selected pair
definitions.completion_miss: actual Top3 contains the selected pair but its third horse is outside the fixed K completion candidates
definitions.hit: actual unordered Top3 equals one of the K selected triples

tie_policy_proposal.confidence_bins: five equal-width bins over [0,1], fixed before outcome tabulation; always show bin counts
